frame: Open-source apps on F-Droid updated since 2025-10-21 whose latest F-Droid build targets 35 or lower, source on GitHub, GitLab or Codeberg, with a Google Play listing under the same package name on 2026-10-21 (the frame of our Back handlers note)
notes: pattern_counts are census/analyse.py output. A target the pattern could not read counts as not at 36 there; we then read those targets by hand (version catalogs, root-project variables, CMake defaults). The per-app list is not published.
